perception_loop.assessment: There were two explicit framed looks, both legally scoped to the page-frame. Turn 7 established the broad layout, substantial construction followed, and turn 70 provided a clean whole-board QA render before finalize. This forms one broad render→adjust/build→render loop. However, the dense reviewer fan-out, aggregation fan-in, and lower feedback routes were not inspected with region-specific close-ups during construction; nearly all detailed work occurred between the two whole-page looks. No adjustment followed the final QA render.

Despite explicitly entering a checking phase, the agent continued editing a dense region without first taking a close-up of that region.

lint_etiquette.assessment: Lint handling was disciplined. No lint ERROR occurred. Every warning was addressed rather than overridden: clipped stickies were resized or shortened, and unreadable edge labels were shortened. The review-contract resize at turn 60 missed the required height by five pixels, but the next turn changed strategy by shortening the text, so this was not a lint fight. Final diagnostics were clean, with no warning requiring a commit-summary override reason.

commit_honesty.assessment: The single commit summary accurately describes the stage diff and final render. The diff contains five reviewer objects, aggregator and verifier paths including withheld/demoted findings, cancellation and restart controls, calibration feedback, and budget/telemetry notes. The summary does not claim visual rebalancing or unsupported behavior, and no defect explicitly seen or named by the agent remained undeclared at commit.

economy.assessment: The session used 72 total tool calls producing 51 committed patch operations, proportionate to a large workflow with six sections, many nodes, and 20 connections. There were no add-delete-rebuild cycles, repeated NO-OPs, or other thrash. The 8.3-minute wall time was comfortably below the 15-minute session budget, and finalize was reached well below the 300-turn limit.

moments.finding: Corrective work modified the existing object rather than deleting and rebuilding it.
A single fit operation efficiently tightened the final frame before QA.
The agent completed and finalized without exhausting either the wall-time or turn budget.

infra_exclusions.assessment: No infrastructure failure was declared or visible. The sole session completed normally, had zero retries, and committed successfully, so no session is excluded from scoring.
